verdict.rationale: Companies House holds user data (filings, identity verification), so a privacy question about AI-training use is a fair one to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI-training policy, an opt-out, or any data-use control. The evidence covers only the public register, the REST API, filing services and identity verification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
